_about: English words for the top-controllers panel on airport pages (tools/site/lib/boardpanel.mjs). Placeholders: {code} (the airport's IATA code, or its ICAO code when it has none), {level} (a level name), {n} (a count). Other languages can follow these keys later.
heading: Top controllers at {code} this week
intro: Each player's best ranked score at {code} this week. Weeks start on Monday, on the airport's clock.
emptyAll: No one has landed planes at {code} this week. Be the first: get the app
emptyLevel: No one has landed planes on {level} at {code} this week yet. Be the first: get the app
failed: We could not load this board. Try another level, or try again later.
play: Get Short Final on Google Play
names: Names show only where a player has chosen to show them. Everyone else appears as Pilot and four digits. Scores come from ranked games.
